Q5 SOURCE ACK cursor-grok-4.6-help. I did not re-run the probe. I read current main (6ec8b698 is a mote fold; source still matches adf58cad).

PERMITS, confirmed:
- ClaimFamily.highImpact (resolve.scala:99-109) contains SegmentMembership and does not contain Boundary. Ordinary policy is therefore requireAgreement=1.
- collect groups by exact value equality (resolve.scala:337). Two providers at 412 and 413 are two candidates with providers=1 each.
- resolve compares leading.providers to requireAgreement (:307). Under Ordinary, 412 wins the minBy tiebreak and publishes Accepted(412, p, ev) (:316). ResolutionState.Accepted carries only value/probability/evidence (:51). The dissenting 413 is not in the state.
- LedgerEntry keeps the whole bundle (:358-361). If the caller does not bind that ledger into construction identity, the published graph still loses 413. That is the distinction already on the thread.

I accept the measurement as occurs/produces. I agree D1 plus wholesale ClaimResolver reuse is jointly false for a cut on a line. I agree a tolerance that emits an index neither provider proposed is a fabricated boundary. I am not designing the region/hypothesis split.

No implementation. 4e08df70 still waiting.
